svg.text: 7 rafters Cedar 2x6 S4S (1 per post), cloud-lift ends
16 slats Cedar 2x4 S4S (flat) per bay, 1 11/16" gap
Kitchen Privacy Screen — 7 posts, cedar with pergola top
Dimensions in feet/inches. Lumber: actual sizes (2x6 = 1 1/2" x 5 1/2").
Verify all dimensions in the field before cutting. Not a structural design.
1. Overall length 22'-1"; 7 posts at 3'-7 1/4" o.c.; clear bay 3'-1 3/4".
2. Bay/post = 6.86 ≈ φ^4 = 6.85 (Fibonacci 89/13); slat span 3'-1 3/4" > 36" conservative limit (< 48" max): more risk of bowing.
3. Post cores embedded 2'-0" in concrete over 6" gravel; holes by machine auger.
4. Call NC811 before digging. Verify property line, setbacks and HOA.
5. Fasteners: coated trim-head deck screws (ACQ-rated), countersunk.
6. 16 slats per bay, 1 11/16" gap set by the notched side boards.
7. All posts 5 1/2" wide, faces flush. Parts marked YES are pre-cut in the shop.
8. Cedar = Western Red Cedar, kiln-dried, S4S (planed 4 sides).
9. PT = Southern Yellow Pine #2, ground contact.
